**Finding: deviation (WARRANTY)** — submitted.

- **What the document has:** § 5.1 warrants Services performed with "reasonable care and skill" using qualified personnel, plus a covenant to comply with laws applicable to IBM's business. § 5.2 makes those the exclusive warranties.
- **What is missing:** no conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no warranty period, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no remedy (repair/replace/re-perform/refund). § 5.4(c) affirmatively puts all Materials on an unqualified "AS IS" footing, and §§ 5.4(a)–(b) disclaim error-free operation, capacity and performance. Support in §§ 11.1/12.2 is discretionary ("as reasonably determined by IBM"), so it is not a substitute remedy.
- **Why deviation, not fallback:** the fallback still requires a conformance warranty (90 days software / 30 days services) with real remedies; neither element exists, so the clause fails on material terms while stopping just short of full walk-away AS IS.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** new § 5.1(c) adding a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with a re-perform/repair/replace/refund remedy, plus an "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1" carve-out at the head of § 5.4(c) so the disclaimer no longer swallows the express warranty.
